//MudVolcano: The event card hw_tgr_mudvolcano spawns, in the shape of vanilla Event_FallLaceration (36db4f020478b1444b20bb8c8c107c21): a CardType 3 whose one button destroys the event card (ReceivingCardChanges.ModType 3, which is also what lets the button pass WillHaveAnEffect and render). The button ALWAYS dirties: one StatModification of +30 on vanilla Filth (111606ba528c30e4f8e38494f41b92c7, the same +30 Event_FallLaceration writes; Filth has a base rate of 0 and a range of 0 to 500, so the mud stays until the player washes, which is vanilla's own cleaning). It SOMETIMES burns: a two-collection ProducedCards, Burn (weight MUDVOLCANO_BURN_WEIGHT 40, exactly one vanilla W_FireBurn, 3ba0c209e55d7cb4d8da51697e34b584, by GUID) against Splash (weight 60, a card-less drop), so about two eruptions in five burn. Both weights are TUNABLE PLACEHOLDERS, session-inferred and unmeasured against play. The card names no Forest Lore card and has no target list, so it needs no load guard; it can only reach the player. Gated by Development_Tools/Tests/HarshWilds-MudVolcano.Tests.ps1.

CardDescription.DefaultText: The crater heaves, bulges and bursts, throwing hot grey mud across the ground around it.
